I have tried to play this game two times before on my PS5 and each time I simply left it because I got discouraged by the pace at the beginning and expected something more engaging. I was also under the misconception that this game was hyper realistic and required contant feeding and sleeping etc. It does not and the realism mechanics do not make the game any less enjoyable. 

Third time is the charm and I am grateful I gave this game an another chance, because it is one of the best titles I have ever played. It is a game meant to be taken slowly. Let the story and the enviorment sink in. Enjoy the exploration and every random interaction you have in the world. 

I recommend doing a high honour playthrough, as it ties into the story really well.

reviews.review:
Red Dead Redemption 2 isn't just a game to me. It's an experience I'll never forget.

Growing up in the countryside, the open fields, quiet mornings, mountains, and sounds of nature reminded me so much of home. There's something about this world that feels familiar in a way I can't quite explain.

I enjoyed every moment of this masterpiece. The storytelling, the characters, the atmosphere, and the incredible attention to detail make the world feel truly alive. Every character has something to offer, and even the smallest moments feel meaningful.

I've played many games, but very few have left an impression on me like this one. It's more than just a beautiful open world; it's an experience that stays with you long after it's over.
